description: Feasibility of Locating Leakages in Sewage Pressure Pipes Using the Distributed Temperature Sensing Technology is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Benjamin Apperl (deposited on HydroShare). The cost effective maintenance of underwater pressure pipes for sewage disposal in Austria requires the detection and localization of leakages. Extrusion of wastewater in lakes can heavily influence the water and bathing quality of surrounding waters. The Distributed Temperature Sensing (DTS) technology is a widely used technique for oil and gas pipeline leakage detection. Coverage: not restricted to one place in the metadata. The resource was created 2017-12-29 and last updated 2018-04-09; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
